name: Baked with Love
source:
A cute little story about you moving back to your home town to help your grandma in the family bakery. You meet some old friends but also some new faces.

[From [url=https://lolodedodo.itch.io/baked-with-love]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部温馨可爱的短篇故事：你搬回故乡小镇，到家里的面包房给祖母搭手帮忙，并在那里重逢了昔日老友，也结识了崭新的面孔。

[摘自[url=https://lolodedodo.itch.io/baked-with-love]itch.io[/url]]
